59: func (p *pbmCollector) collect(ch chan<- prometheus.Metric) {
60: 	defer measureCollectTime(ch, "mongodb", "pbm")()
61: 
62: 	var metrics []prometheus.Metric
63: 	logger := p.base.logger
64: 
65: 	createMetric := func(name, help string, value float64, labels map[string]string) {
66: 		const prefix = "mongodb_pbm_"
67: 		d := prometheus.NewDesc(prefix+name, help, nil, labels)
68: 		metrics = append(metrics, prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(d, prometheus.GaugeValue, value))
69: 	}
70: 
71: 	pbmClient, err := sdk.NewClient(p.ctx, p.mongoURI)
72: 	if err != nil {
73: 		logger.Errorf("failed to create PBM client: %s", err.Error())
74: 		return
75: 	}
76: 
77: 	pbmConfig, err := pbmClient.GetConfig(p.ctx)
78: 	if err != nil {
79: 		logger.Errorf("failed to get PBM configuration: %s", err.Error())
80: 		return
81: 	}
82: 
83: 	if pbmConfig != nil {
84: 		createMetric("cluster_backup_configured",
85: 			"PBM backups are configured for the cluster",
86: 			float64(1), nil)
87: 
88: 		if pbmConfig.PITR.Enabled {
89: 			createMetric("cluster_pitr_backup_enabled",
90: 				"PBM PITR backups are enabled for the cluster",
91: 				float64(1), nil)
92: 		}
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	metrics = append(metrics, pbmBackupsMetrics(p.ctx, pbmClient, logger)...)
96: 	metrics = append(metrics, p.pbmAgentMetrics(p.ctx, pbmClient, logger)...)
97: 
98: 	for _, metric := range metrics {
99: 		ch <- metric
100: 	}
101: }

103: func (p *pbmCollector) pbmAgentMetrics(ctx context.Context, pbmClient *sdk.Client, l *logrus.Entry) []prometheus.Metric {
104: 	clusterStatus, err := cli.ClusterStatus(ctx, pbmClient, cli.RSConfGetter(p.mongoURI))
105: 	if err != nil {
106: 		l.Errorf("failed to get cluster status: %s", err.Error())
107: 		return nil
108: 	}
109: 
110: 	metrics := make([]prometheus.Metric, 0, len(clusterStatus))
111: 	createMetric := func(name, help string, value float64, labels map[string]string) {
112: 		const prefix = "mongodb_pbm_"
113: 		d := prometheus.NewDesc(prefix+name, help, nil, labels)
114: 		metrics = append(metrics, prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(d, prometheus.GaugeValue, value))
115: 	}
116: 
117: 	for replsetName, nodes := range clusterStatus {
118: 		for _, node := range nodes {
119: 			switch {
120: 			case node.OK:
121: 				createMetric("agent_status",
122: 					"PBM Agent Status",
123: 					float64(pbmAgentStatusOK),
124: 					map[string]string{
125: 						"host":        node.Host,
126: 						"replica_set": replsetName,
127: 						"role":        string(node.Role),
128: 					})
129: 
130: 			case node.IsAgentLost():
131: 				createMetric("agent_status",
132: 					"PBM Agent Status",
133: 					float64(pbmAgentStatusLost),
134: 					map[string]string{
135: 						"host":        node.Host,
136: 						"replica_set": replsetName,
137: 						"role":        string(node.Role),
138: 					})
139: 
140: 			default: // !node.OK
141: 				createMetric("agent_status",
142: 					"PBM Agent Status",
143: 					float64(pbmAgentStatusError),
144: 					map[string]string{
145: 						"host":        node.Host,
146: 						"replica_set": replsetName,
147: 						"role":        string(node.Role),
148: 					})
149: 			}
150: 		}
151: 	}
152: 
153: 	return metrics
154: }

156: func pbmBackupsMetrics(ctx context.Context, pbmClient *sdk.Client, l *logrus.Entry) []prometheus.Metric {
157: 	backupsList, err := pbmClient.GetAllBackups(ctx)
158: 	if err != nil {
159: 		l.Errorf("failed to get PBM backup list: %s", err.Error())
160: 		return nil
161: 	}
162: 
163: 	metrics := make([]prometheus.Metric, 0, len(backupsList))
164: 	createMetric := func(name, help string, value float64, labels map[string]string) {
165: 		const prefix = "mongodb_pbm_"
166: 		d := prometheus.NewDesc(prefix+name, help, nil, labels)
167: 		metrics = append(metrics, prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(d, prometheus.GaugeValue, value))
168: 	}
169: 
170: 	for _, backup := range backupsList {
171: 		createMetric("backup_size",
172: 			"Size of PBM backup",
173: 			float64(backup.Size), map[string]string{
174: 				"opid":   backup.OPID,
175: 				"status": string(backup.Status),
176: 				"name":   backup.Name,
177: 			})
178: 
179: 		var endTime int64
180: 		switch backup.Status { //nolint:exhaustive
181: 		case defs.StatusDone, defs.StatusCancelled, defs.StatusError, defs.StatusDown:
182: 			endTime = backup.LastTransitionTS
183: 		default:
184: 			endTime = time.Now().Unix()
185: 		}
186: 
187: 		duration := time.Unix(endTime-backup.StartTS, 0).Unix()
188: 		createMetric("backup_duration_seconds",
189: 			"Duration of PBM backup",
190: 			float64(duration), map[string]string{
191: 				"opid":   backup.OPID,
192: 				"status": string(backup.Status),
193: 				"name":   backup.Name,
194: 			})
195: 	}
196: 	return metrics
197: }
